content.text: The Philadelphia Phillies (1-0) look for a second straight win over the Texas Rangers (0-1) when the teams continue their three-game season-opening series on Saturday afternoon at Citizens Bank Park in Philadelphia.PHILADELPHIA, PENNSYLVANIA - MARCH 26: Alec Bohm #28 of the Philadelphia Phillies celebrates after hitting a three-run home run in the fifth inning ag...How to Watch Rangers vs PhilliesDate: Saturday, March 28, 2026Time: 3:00 PM ETChannel: MLB.TV - Philadelphia Phillies, Rangers Sports NetworkStream: Fubo (TRY FOR FREE)Cristopher Sanchez struck out 10 in six scoreless innings on Thursday while Kyle Schwarber got the offense rolling with a two-run homer in the first inning as Philadelphia picked up a 5-3 win. Alec Bohm added a three-run shot in the fifth inning and Jhoan Duran got the final two outs to thwart a Rangers rally in the ninth. Rookie Justin Crawford had two hits in his major-league debut, batting ninth and playing center field.Jake Burger got Texas on the board with a two-run homer in the ninth inning and Danny Jansen singled home a run to make it a 5-3 game before the rally died out. Nathan Eovaldi didn’t make it out of the fifth, giving up five runs on eight hits while fanning seven before the bullpen allowed only two hits the rest of the way.Veteran Aaron Nola comes off his worst season in 2025, posting a 6.01 ERA and 1.346 WHIP in 17 starts and 94.1 innings for the Phillies, and looks to start a rebound when he gets the start on Saturday.
